//: Server configuration for the npx serve startup command on App Service. The startup command in app01-prod17-if-east-us is 'npx serve /home/site/wwwroot -l 8080'; this file is picked up automatically when present at the served root.
//trailingSlash: MkDocs builds with use_directory_urls: True, which produces folder-per-page output (e.g. /booklets/boop-and-wobble-meet/index.html served as /booklets/boop-and-wobble-meet/). When a user types or pastes the URL without the trailing slash, the browser treats the last segment as a file when resolving relative links, breaking every relative href on the page. Forcing trailingSlash: true makes serve redirect /booklets/boop-and-wobble-meet -> /booklets/boop-and-wobble-meet/ so the browser resolves children correctly.
//cleanUrls: serve defaults to stripping known extensions from URLs (e.g. /downloads/foo.pdf -> /downloads/foo). Disable so PDF and other binary URLs resolve as written.
//headers: Security headers and Cache-Control rules modeled on spatialobservability.org/public/serve.json. CSP intentionally omitted in this pass — the kids site loads Google Fonts from fonts.googleapis.com/fonts.gstatic.com and Material for MkDocs injects inline styles/scripts for palette and search; CSP needs a Report-Only audit pass before enforcement. Tracked for a follow-up commit.

headers.value: accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()

headers.//assets: MkDocs writes JS and CSS bundles into /assets/ with content-hashed filenames (e.g. assets/javascripts/bundle.83f73b43.min.js). Safe to cache aggressively because the hash changes on every content change.

headers.//favicon: Favicon family changes rarely. One-month cache strikes a balance between staleness and request volume.

headers.//webmanifest: PWA manifest changes occasionally; short cache so updates propagate within an hour.

headers.//html: HTML pages should revalidate so content updates are visible within an hour without forcing a full re-fetch on every page load. must-revalidate disallows serving stale.
